newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson says signs U.S. contract.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson says signs U.S. contract.

text.p: Swedish telecommunications company L.M. Ericsson AB said on Tuesday it had reached agreement to supply network equipment to Omnipoint Communications Inc for the Philadelphia Basic Trading Area.

The two companies also extended their original Personal Communications Services (PCS) contract for Ominpoint IS-661 and GSM network equipment and services by 1.8 billion crowns bringing their total business to 4.4 billion crowns.
The contract includes mobile switching centres, base station controllers and radio base station equipment as well as implementation and support services, Ericsson said in a statement.
Under the terms of the agreement, Omnipoint's IS-661 technology will be supported in Ericsson's base station controller and operation support systems.
"This contract extension further solidifies our relationships with Omnipoint for today and the future," Ericsson spokesman Jan-Anders Dalenstam said.
